source: Ed4 C.6.5 and C.6.6, pp.C-71 to C-73; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6
description: A block that holds no byte of a valid D_PDU but is all zero, the modem's zero fill, is not a lost block: the burst stays clean and the probe follows.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1) as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run with probe_run 3. Flow as drc-rx-capability-records-ed4: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long, block 256 bytes) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, whose 21 EOWs are the top priority of Table C-25 (MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED), then SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04, then the rotation MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF from its start (interp C-1260, C-1286). Earlier bursts (burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later and, for a second block, 40 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) hold a PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105), or a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (a D_PDU error, C-0836), or a block of 16 bytes with no sync that are not all zero. Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (C-0462, C-0469). Table positions: WN 2, 4, 6, 7 Long are 0 to 3; thresholds on WN 2 Long bulk -100, 50, 150, 300 and latency -100, 100, 200, 400; on WN 4 Long bulk -100, 0, 100, 150 and latency -100, 100, 300, 400; on WN 6 Long bulk -100, 0, 300, 500 and latency -100, 200, 400, 600; on WN 7 Long bulk -100, -50, 100, 400 and latency -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8. Since corpus 0.36.0 (P7-9 round 3) a move up by the estimate goes straight to its target after the clean run, not one rung (interp C-1270), each recommendation walks only the ladder positions bulk_rungs or latency_rungs give (all when null), and a burst with a lost block is not clean (corpus-format.md 6.2). At 100 a clean burst on WN 4 Long, estimate 50: MAX-SPEED WN 4 Long, LOW-SPEED WN 2 Long (as drc-rx-probe-after-clean-run); WN 4 Long's clean run is 1. At 200 a burst on WN 4 Long, estimate 50, of two blocks: a PADDING, then 16 zero bytes (the modem's zero fill after the last D_PDU). The second block holds no byte of a D_PDU with a valid header, but its bytes are all zero, so it is not a lost block (corpus-format.md 6.2 as revised in corpus 0.36.0, P7-9 round 3) and the burst is clean: the clean run is 2. The CAPABILITY burst, clean, on WN 4 Long, estimate 50: the clean run is 3, the target (1) is not above MAX-SPEED, so the probe moves MAX-SPEED up one rung to WN 6 Long; LOW-SPEED holds at WN 2 Long. EOWs: 0x8A6, 0x9A2, 0xB04, then 0x8A6, 0x9A2, 0xAFF repeated, 21 in all, as drc-rx-probe-after-clean-run; drc-rx-lost-block-not-clean is the same flow with the block not zero.
